suite.message: Here lies Old Mimic, who fought bravely to defend the Kariba against invaders.
Here lies Young Mimic, who passed long before he was due. May the Mother protect him from beyond.
Here lies Peegle, our loyal watchman and forever-brother.
Here lies Tom Hollow, husband to Amber Hollow and father of Dale, Lylem, and Lucie. May he rest in forever-peace.
Here lies Jura, beloved music-maker and worm-singer. May his soul dwell evermore within the Mother.
Here lies Baya, beloved wife of Jura, who crafted chitin instruments for the Mother. Her soul will be forever protected by her music.
